basic_info.description: Welcome to the incredible 176 Goethe Street! This spacious home offers a flexible floor plan for family and friends to find harmony at home! The upper unit features two bedrooms and two bathrooms +2 additional rooms which could be used as an office, playroom or with a simple installation of a closet could function as bedrooms as well giving you plenty of space! The large living and dining room are an open concept design, which allows you to entertain at your will! The laundry room allows access to the stairway for you to enjoy your yard and one-car garage. Lets not forget about the one bedroom one bathroom lower unit with additional bonus room, which has been recently painted and has new flooring! Also downstairs is a fourth bathroom directly off the garage And laundry/storage room! There are so many reasons to make this incredible house, your home! Put it on your must see list, today!
